english.note: Use this after an action verb when the action has been completed in full, as in 做晒 for “finish it all.”
Use this colloquial construction when an action is done to the whole amount or all relevant items, rather than to emphasize thoroughness.

examples.jyutping: di1 gung1 fo3 ngo5 zou6 saai3 laa3

examples.english: They completely ate all the fish on the plate.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 sik6 saai3 dip6 jyu4 laa3
